blocks.text: Hum Cartesian coordinate system parh chuke hain. Asal mein frame of reference koi bhi aisa coordinate system hai jis ke hisab se naap (measurement) li jati hai. Misal: kamre mein mez ki jagah kamre ki deewaron ke hisab se batai ja sakti hai, to kamra frame of reference hai. Isi tarah laboratory mein li gayi naap ka frame laboratory hai. Yahi experiment (tajurba) chalti train mein karein to train frame of reference ban jati hai. Spaceship ki jagah door ke sitaron ke hisab se batai ja sakti hai; tab un sitaron par based (mabni) coordinate system frame of reference banta hai.
Inertial aur non-inertial frame of reference

Inertial frame of reference woh coordinate system hai jis mein inertia (yani apni halat qaim rakhne ki aadat) ka law durust ho. Yani ruki hui cheez ruki rehti hai jab tak us par koi unbalanced force (jo acceleration paida kare) na lage. Is mein nature (qudrat) ke doosre laws bhi lagu hote hain. Misal: zameen par rakhi cheez ruki rehti hai jab tak us par unbalanced force na lage, is liye zameen ko inertial frame mana ja sakta hai. Zameen ke relative (muqable mein) uniform velocity se chalti car mein rakhi cheez bhi ruki rehti hai, is liye car bhi inertial frame hai. Yani kisi inertial frame ke relative uniform velocity se chalne wala har frame bhi inertial hai.

Magar agar chalti car achanak ruk jaye ya tez ho (accelerate kare), to andar rakhi cheez ruki nahi rehti; aage ya peeche sarak jati hai. Aise case mein car inertial frame nahi. Is liye accelerated (jis ki velocity badal rahi ho) frame non-inertial frame hai. Zameen ghoomti (rotate) aur Suraj ke gird chakkar (revolve) lagati hai, is liye strictly (bilkul theek) dekhein to woh non-inertial hai, magar us ka acceleration bohat kam hai, is liye aksar use inertial frame mana jata hai.

blocks.text: Relativity yeh parhti hai ke chalte hue frames of reference ke observers ko duniya kaise nazar aati hai.

blocks.prompt: Frame of reference kya hai? Misalon ke saath inertial aur non-inertial frames mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Frame of reference aisa coordinate system hai jis ke hisab se jagah aur motion (harkat) naapi jati hai, jaise kamra, laboratory, chalti train ya door ke sitare. Inertial frame mein inertia ka law durust hai: ruki cheez ruki rehti hai aur chalti cheez apni velocity rakhti hai jab tak unbalanced force na lage; misal: zameen (kaafi had tak) aur uniform velocity se chalti car. Non-inertial frame accelerate kar raha hota hai: achanak brake lagne par car mein rakha thaila aage sarak jata hai halan ke koi force use nahi dhakelti, yani wahan inertia ka law nahi chalta.

items: Frame of reference: naap ke liye koi bhi coordinate system (kamra, laboratory, train, sitare).

Inertial: inertia ka law durust (zameen taqreeban, uniform velocity wali car); inertial frame ke relative uniform velocity se chalne wala har frame inertial. Non-inertial: accelerated frame (brake lagati ya tez hoti car).
